result.summary: Review of config precedence/empty values/path anchoring/legacy DB at exact target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (branch feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Verdict FINDINGS: 2 MEDIUM, 3 LOW, no CRITICAL/HIGH. The documented 6-layer precedence ladder and the path-anchoring matrix both reproduce exactly and are correct. F1 MEDIUM: an empty string in a TOML int/bool field (src/settings/load.ts:370) is a hard config_invalid error, not 'unset', contradicting docs/CONFIGURATION.md:51-52 and disagreeing with the text kind. F2 MEDIUM: legacy DB default ./data/swarmforge.sqlite (src/config.ts:77) is relocated to the XDG path (src/settings/load.ts:835) with no startup signal. F3 LOW: '--url ""' is silently ignored. F4 LOW: server.api_token never reaches the client surface. F5 LOW: config path omits the config's own env_file. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json; log rev36-probe.log.
result.details:
SCOPE: src/settings/load.ts, src/settings/paths.ts, src/settings/inspect.ts, src/cli/arguments.ts, src/cli.ts config wiring, src/config.ts legacy loader, docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

VERIFIED CORRECT: ladder config < config.env_file < --env-file < process env < overrides reproduces exactly with provenance naming each winning layer (load.ts:785-822); empty value in an env/override layer leaves the lower layer intact; comma lists replace not merge; anchoring matrix matches docs (config paths at config dir, env/env-file/flags at cwd, ':memory:' verbatim, tilde expanded); legacy relative DB paths are not relocated when explicitly set; SWARMFORGE_CONFIG read only from overrides/process env; non-loopback allowed_hosts still requires api_token.

F1 MEDIUM src/settings/load.ts:370 - kinds.int/kinds.bool reject '' during documentSchema.safeParse before setValue's empty-means-unset rule runs, while kind 'text' accepts '' as unset. Reproduced: '[server] port = ""' -> SettingsError config_invalid 'must match pattern /^-?\d+$/'; metrics_enabled = "" -> config_invalid; allowed_hosts = "" resolves fine. Guard gap: tests/settings.test.ts:623 covers empty only via env_file/overrides, never an empty TOML scalar. Trigger is a templated config like port = "${PORT}" with the variable unset; serve then refuses to start.

F2 MEDIUM src/settings/load.ts:835 - legacy src/config.ts:77 default './data/swarmforge.sqlite' replaced by defaultDatabasePath() (paths.ts:67). Reproduced: legacy loadConfig -> ./data/swarmforge.sqlite; new resolveServerSettings -> <home>/.local/share/swarmforge/swarmforge.sqlite, provenance 'default'. renderStartup (serve-command.ts:151) prints host/port/metrics but never the DB path, so an upgraded deployment silently opens an empty DB and orphans the old one. Documented in prose (CONFIGURATION.md:129-133, migration step 4 :264) but no runtime guard; tests/settings.test.ts:407 only covers an explicitly set path.

F3 LOW src/cli/arguments.ts:66 - value() rejects only a missing value, so '--url ""' becomes overrides.SWARMFORGE_URL="" and applyEnvironment skips it at load.ts:701. Reproduced: resolved url came from the config file with provenance 'config:...', no error, while '--config ""' fails loudly (config_invalid EISDIR).

F4 LOW src/settings/load.ts:869 - resolveClientSettings applies only clientFields, so server.api_token never feeds the client token. Reproduced: client.value has no token, provenance token='default', secrets [], while the same file gives server SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN present=true. docs/CONFIGURATION.md:63 and :68 map both keys to SWARMFORGE_API_TOKEN, implying one value, so status 401s with no config-side hint.

F5 LOW src/cli.ts:235 - reportConfigPath maps only command.envFiles and never reads the document. Reproduced end-to-end with the local CLI (exit 0): env_files listed only the --env-file, omitting the config's declared secrets.env, against its own comment at cli.ts:209-210.

Read-only: no source changes, no commits/pushes/tags. /workspace/repo remains at assigned baseline 5672ead, clean. Disposable detached checkout at /tmp/opencode/rev36/repo verified with git rev-parse HEAD = d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895.

result.followup_reason: Two MEDIUM actionable defects: (1) src/settings/load.ts:370 - an empty string in a TOML int/bool field raises config_invalid instead of meaning 'unset', contradicting docs/CONFIGURATION.md:51-52 and inconsistent with the text kind; accept '' in the int/bool unions and skip it in applyDocument, or narrow the doc. (2) src/settings/load.ts:835 with src/config.ts:77 - the legacy './data/swarmforge.sqlite' default is silently replaced by the XDG path; add a startup warning/refusal when the default is used and ./data/swarmforge.sqlite exists, and render the resolved database path in the startup banner. Three LOW items are also actionable: src/cli/arguments.ts:66 ('--url ""' silently ignored), src/settings/load.ts:869 (server.api_token not visible to the client surface, contradicting docs/CONFIGURATION.md:63 vs :68), src/cli.ts:235 (config path omits the config's own env_file). Full evidence, reproductions and recommended corrections are in /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md and findings.json.
